scope: All 88 existing non-pronunciation leaves; authored finite cases, not all possible English errors

correct_control.context: Ordinary statement about attending an institution.
correct_control.reason: Institutional school needs no article here.

correct_control.context: General material, not a serving or a specific batch.
correct_control.reason: A general mass noun can have zero article.

correct_control.context: Ordinary spoken English; university begins with /j/.
correct_control.reason: The following sound, not the written vowel, selects a.

correct_control.context: Several previously introduced books at a distance.
correct_control.reason: Those agrees with plural books.

correct_control.context: Ordinary description of one of my sisters.
correct_control.text: A sister of mine lives here.
correct_control.reason: A sister of mine is licensed; a my sister is different.

correct_control.context: An amount of measured time.
correct_control.text: It took less than five minutes.
correct_control.reason: Less with an amount of time is permitted; a blanket fewer rule is false.

correct_control.context: More than one additional chair.
correct_control.reason: Other is licensed with the plural; another is not universally required.

correct_control.context: Two animals of the sheep species.
correct_control.reason: Sheep has an invariant plural.

correct_control.context: A café order for two servings.
correct_control.reason: Coffee is countable for servings.

correct_control.context: A car belonging to my brother.
correct_control.reason: The possessive is licensed; written apostrophes alone cannot be heard.

correct_control.context: Ordinary money container, not a playful coinage.
correct_control.text: I put it in my wallet.
correct_control.reason: The ordinary noun wallet is valid.

correct_control.context: Casual response to Who is at the door?
correct_control.reason: Object-form me is normal after be in this context.

categories.canonical: The key is here; it is on the table.
categories.mutated: The key is here; she is on the table.

correct_control.context: A woman has been introduced explicitly.
correct_control.text: Lea arrived; she is waiting outside.
correct_control.reason: The audible antecedent licenses she.

categories.canonical: I saw both cars and photographed them.
categories.mutated: I saw both cars and photographed it.

correct_control.context: Someone of unspecified gender has left property.
correct_control.reason: Singular they/their is licensed.

correct_control.context: The speaker emphasizes doing the work personally.
correct_control.reason: An intensive reflexive need not be an object.

categories.canonical: The car whose roof leaks is mine.
categories.mutated: The car who roof leaks is mine.

correct_control.context: An integrated restrictive relative about a person.
correct_control.text: The person that called is here.
correct_control.reason: Restrictive that can refer to people.

correct_control.context: Casual left dislocation with a separate topic intonation.
correct_control.reason: Conversational left dislocation licenses the resumptive pronoun.

correct_control.context: The speaker explicitly tells a vivid story in the historical present.
correct_control.text: So yesterday I walk into the shop, and everyone cheers.
correct_control.reason: The narrative present is licensed by the stated storytelling mode.

correct_control.context: A sports commentator describes live action.
correct_control.text: She passes, he shoots, and he scores!
correct_control.reason: Commentary present is not an aspect error.

correct_control.context: A permitted American English question with yet.
correct_control.reason: American past simple with yet can be correct.

correct_control.context: British English; team members act separately.
correct_control.text: The team are putting on their shirts.
correct_control.reason: Plural collective agreement is permitted here.

correct_control.context: Casual conversation with you and a recoverable auxiliary.
correct_control.reason: Conversational auxiliary ellipsis is licensed.

correct_control.context: An emphatic correction to a denial.
correct_control.reason: Emphatic did takes the base form; it is not redundant error.

categories.canonical: You must not enter the room.

correct_control.context: Attendance is optional and the speaker is not issuing an indirect criticism.
correct_control.text: You don't have to attend, but you may.
correct_control.reason: Non-obligation does not mean prohibition.

correct_control.context: Ordinary advice with ought.
correct_control.reason: Ought to does not follow the bare-infinitive pattern of can.

correct_control.context: The person pauses another activity in order to drink.
correct_control.text: She stopped to drink some water.
correct_control.reason: Stop to drink and stop drinking express different valid meanings.

correct_control.context: American English past participle of get.
correct_control.reason: Gotten is a licensed American participle.

categories.canonical: She is working at a bank.

correct_control.context: A fragment answering What is she doing?
correct_control.reason: A conversational answer fragment need not be a complete finite sentence.

categories.canonical: The window was broken by him.
categories.mutated: The window was break by him.

correct_control.context: The window breaks; no agent is asserted.
correct_control.reason: An intransitive event does not require passive be.

correct_control.context: Passive causative make.
correct_control.reason: Passive made licenses to, unlike active made me wait.

correct_control.context: A permitted standard regular alternative.
correct_control.reason: Learned is valid even where learnt is also used.

correct_control.context: American English time expression.
correct_control.text: We will meet on the weekend.
correct_control.reason: On the weekend is an acceptable regional choice.

correct_control.context: Hear takes a direct object.
correct_control.reason: Hear does not require the to required by listen.

correct_control.context: Talk selects about for a topic.
correct_control.reason: A preposition valid with talk is not licensed with every synonym.

correct_control.context: A separable verb with a full noun object.
correct_control.reason: The full noun can follow the particle.

correct_control.context: A direct information question.
correct_control.reason: Direct question inversion differs from embedded question order.

correct_control.context: A direct subject question asking for the person.
correct_control.reason: Subject wh-questions do not require did.

correct_control.context: A deliberate logical double negation, not negative concord.
correct_control.reason: Two negative elements can express a positive possibility.

correct_control.context: An ordinary imperative.
correct_control.reason: Imperatives normally omit an explicit subject.

categories.canonical: There is a book on the desk.
categories.mutated: It is a book on the desk.

correct_control.context: Identification of an already discussed object.
correct_control.text: What is that? It is a book on the desk.
correct_control.reason: Referential it is not an existential error.

categories.canonical: She explained the rule to me.

correct_control.context: Tell licenses a double-object frame.
correct_control.reason: A frame valid with tell need not be valid with explain.

categories.canonical: Although it was raining, we left.

correct_control.context: An answer to Why did you leave?
correct_control.reason: A meaningful conversational subordinate answer is acceptable.

categories.canonical: The book which I read was good.
categories.mutated: The book which I read it was good.

correct_control.context: An integrated object relative.
correct_control.text: The book I read was excellent.
correct_control.reason: The object relative pronoun can be omitted.

categories.canonical: If I were rich, I would buy a boat.
categories.mutated: If I were rich, I will buy a boat.

correct_control.context: An open future condition.
correct_control.text: If it rains, we will stay inside.
correct_control.reason: This valid open conditional must not be forced into the remote pattern.

correct_control.context: A repeated comparative expressing change.
correct_control.text: It is getting more and more interesting.
correct_control.reason: More and more is licensed repetition, not redundant comparison marking.

categories.mutated: She enjoys swimming and to read.

correct_control.context: Two clauses share a subject.
correct_control.text: She likes swimming and wants to read.
correct_control.reason: Different heads can license different complement forms.

categories.mutated: Because it rained, so we stayed.

correct_control.context: Two independent spoken intonation units.
correct_control.text: It was raining. So, we stayed at home.
correct_control.reason: Discourse so is licensed; punctuation itself is not acoustic evidence.

correct_control.context: A predicative plural measure.
correct_control.reason: Plural days is required outside the attributive compound.

correct_control.context: Ordinary standard superlative.
correct_control.reason: Best is the irregular superlative of good.

correct_control.context: An explicitly playful creative writing task.
correct_control.reason: A transparent creative derivative is not automatically an error.

correct_control.context: An ordinary flat adverb modifying drive.
correct_control.reason: Fast is a licensed adverb; -ly is not universally required.

categories.canonical: Can I borrow your pen for a minute?
categories.mutated: Can I lend your pen for a minute?

correct_control.context: The owner is asked to transfer a pen temporarily.
correct_control.text: Could you lend me your pen?
correct_control.reason: Lend is correct from the owner's perspective.

correct_control.context: A formal decision statement in a variety permitting take.
correct_control.reason: Take a decision is valid; make is not the only correct collocator.

categories.canonical: It happens once in a blue moon.
categories.mutated: It happens once in a blue sun.

correct_control.context: An explicitly fictional story about a blue sun.
correct_control.text: The planet had a blue sun.
correct_control.reason: Literal words need not obey an unrelated idiom.

categories.canonical: I gave up smoking last year.
categories.mutated: I gave in smoking last year.

correct_control.context: Someone yields after pressure.
correct_control.reason: Give in is valid for yielding, not for quitting smoking.

correct_control.context: A person whose occupation is teaching.
correct_control.reason: The conventional agent noun is valid.

categories.canonical: Sunlight makes my skin hurt. My skin is very sensitive to sunlight.
categories.mutated: Sunlight makes my skin hurt. My skin is very sensible to sunlight.

correct_control.context: A speaker corrects the presupposition that they live elsewhere.
correct_control.reason: Actually is valid for correction; the speaker's first language proves nothing.

categories.canonical: My uncle, my father's brother, visited.
categories.mutated: My aunt, my father's brother, visited.

correct_control.context: One male sibling of the speaker's father.
correct_control.text: My uncle is my father's brother.
correct_control.reason: The kinship term fits the stated relationship.

correct_control.context: Explicit personification in a poem.
correct_control.text: The thirsty earth drank the rain.
correct_control.reason: Metaphorical selection is permitted by genre.

correct_control.context: Ordinary emphatic conversation with no concision constraint.
correct_control.text: I saw it with my own eyes.
correct_control.reason: Redundancy can be purposeful emphasis rather than an English error.

correct_control.context: Casual British conversation.
correct_control.reason: Nicked is permitted in this setting.

categories.mutated: Measured 200 WPM in the fixed exercise

correct_control.context: No rate constraint; the message is understood.
correct_control.text: A clear fast speaker delivering an ordinary greeting
correct_control.reason: Fast is not automatically erroneous; rate and intelligibility differ.

categories.canonical: An internal pause of 0.5 seconds between two permitted phrase groups
categories.mutated: An unplanned internal pause of 4 seconds inside the phrase

correct_control.context: A deliberate dramatic pause in a story.
correct_control.text: She opened the door ... and gasped.
correct_control.reason: A purposeful pause is allowed.

categories.canonical: teacher with no pause inside the word
categories.mutated: teacher with a 2-second silence between tea and cher

correct_control.context: A clause boundary with normal planning time.
correct_control.text: When the rain stopped, [pause] we left.
correct_control.reason: A permissible boundary pause is not an intrusive word split.

categories.mutated: Um, the, um, you know, thing, um...

correct_control.context: Ordinary informal planning, no density ceiling.
correct_control.text: Um, I think we should take the bus.
correct_control.reason: An ordinary planning filler is allowed.

categories.mutated: I I I need the the form.

correct_control.context: Deliberate emphasis.
correct_control.reason: Rhetorical repetition is meaningful.

correct_control.context: A permitted conversational restart that completes the message.
correct_control.text: I wa- I mean, I need the blue form.
correct_control.reason: A resolved false start is acceptable in this setting.

categories.mutated: Go left, no right, or left, I don't know

correct_control.context: A route speaker explicitly corrects a direction.
correct_control.reason: The final direction is unambiguous after a successful repair.

correct_control.context: The full familiar expression is mutually established.
correct_control.reason: A recoverable conventional ellipsis is permitted.

correct_control.context: One filler among 100 words; task limit is at most two fillers per 100 words.
correct_control.reason: This is below the explicit ceiling; no universal clinical norm follows.

categories.canonical: John put the key on the table.
categories.mutated: He put the key on the table.

correct_control.context: Only one named man is in the supplied discourse.
correct_control.text: John came in. He sat down.
correct_control.reason: The unique antecedent is recoverable.

categories.mutated: It rained. However, we cancelled because of the rain.

correct_control.context: The expected cancellation is avoided despite the rain.
correct_control.text: It rained; however, we continued the match.
correct_control.reason: However expresses a genuine contrast here.

categories.canonical: All cats are animals; the reverse does not follow.
categories.mutated: All cats are animals, so all animals are cats.

correct_control.context: A valid one-way class inclusion.
correct_control.text: All cats are animals; that does not mean all animals are cats.
correct_control.reason: The invalid converse is explicitly denied.

categories.canonical: First boil the water, then brew the tea.
categories.mutated: First brew the tea, then boil its water.

correct_control.context: The narrator explicitly marks a flashback.
correct_control.text: She served the tea. Earlier, she had boiled the water.
correct_control.reason: Narrative presentation need not match chronological order.

categories.canonical: At exactly noon, the only key was in Box A and was not in Box B.
categories.mutated: At exactly noon, the only key was in Box A and was not in Box A.

correct_control.context: One arrival is explicitly corrected.
correct_control.reason: An explicit repair supersedes the earlier claim rather than contradicting it unrepaired.

categories.canonical: Walk straight ahead to the hospital entrance.
categories.mutated: My football team won three matches last week.

correct_control.context: A friendly conversation explicitly permits a brief digression.
correct_control.text: Before we discuss the route, may I ask about your trip?
correct_control.reason: The transition and setting license the change.

categories.canonical: Speaker B waits until the complete safety instruction is audible.
categories.mutated: Speaker B overlaps Speaker A and completely masks the critical words do not touch.

correct_control.context: Cooperative conversation permits backchannels without masking content.
correct_control.text: A listener says mm-hm while the speaker continues clearly.
correct_control.reason: Cooperative overlap is not automatically disruptive.

native_context_and_scoring.audio_rendering_gap: No simultaneous/masking controller in the current sequential turn renderer; text captions do not implement overlap.

correct_control.context: The question asks whether a person can attend tonight.
correct_control.reason: The indirect refusal is recoverable from the question.

correct_control.context: A question asks who bought the car.
correct_control.text: It was John who bought the car.
correct_control.reason: A cleft supplies the requested focus.

categories.mutated: He is the one I mean.

correct_control.context: The listener says I did not hear the surname.
correct_control.reason: Repetition can repair a hearing problem.

categories.canonical: Would you please pass the document?
categories.mutated: Hey mate, give us that thing.

correct_control.context: Friendly conversation between peers who use casual address.
correct_control.text: Hi, mate. Can you pass that over?
correct_control.reason: Casual wording fits the stated relationship.

categories.canonical: Excuse me, could I get past?

correct_control.context: An immediate safety hazard requires an urgent warning.
correct_control.reason: Urgent directness is appropriate; indirectness is not always more polite.

categories.canonical: Do not touch the live wire
categories.mutated: Maybe one could perhaps consider not touching the live wire

correct_control.context: A polite ordinary request at a dining table.
correct_control.reason: The indirect question conventionally requests an action.

correct_control.context: A genuine congratulation after a successful exam.
correct_control.reason: The speech act matches the event.

correct_control.context: The addressee explicitly says Please call me Jo.
correct_control.reason: The actual preference controls; nationality or identity is not an oracle.

correct_control.context: The addressees are engineers familiar with the term.
correct_control.reason: Established technical knowledge licenses the terminology.

categories.canonical: I promise I will finish it today.
categories.mutated: I might perhaps finish it today.

correct_control.context: The speaker genuinely does not know whether attendance is possible.
correct_control.text: I might be able to come.
correct_control.reason: Uncertainty is appropriate when no commitment was made.

correct_control.context: A fictional robot's deliberately literal greeting.
correct_control.reason: Creative genre licenses the unusual greeting; unusual is not ungrammatical.
